inclusion_rule: Same population as the M06 topic: human intracranial (ECoG, sEEG, depth, intracortical) studies that decode imagined, covert or inner speech with a trained decoder. Design of interest: how test data are separated from training data (within-participant k-fold, leave-one-out or random trial/block split; held-out session or day; held-out subject; online closed-loop test with features or decoder fixed beforehand). Boundary: attempted speech decoded from unit firing (e.g. Guenther 2009, Brumberg 2011), reviews, listening-only, scalp EEG/MEG and analyses without a decoder excluded; versions count once. Priors: first public before 2020-07 (no 2020 candidate matched).
